原: I’m getting a little fed up with my calls about my claim being completely disregarded, Miss Wilson. / Thank you for calling back.
疑为: I’m getting a little fed up with my calls about my claim being completely disregarded. / Miss Wilson, thank you for calling back.
理由: 称呼 Miss Wilson 是男士下一句话的开头，被切到了女士这句末尾（女士不会称呼自己）

原: …your company has a lawsuit on its hands, you will be hearing from my lawyer.
疑为: …your company has a lawsuit on its hands. You will be hearing from my lawyer.

原: AI, I’m not so optimistic actually.
疑为: Ah, I’m not so optimistic actually.
理由: 开头应为感叹词 Ah，转写成了 AI；译文按“啊”译

原: AI will be able to completely. / Simulate a person in every way possible.
疑为: AI will be able to completely simulate a person in every way possible.
理由: 一句话从副词后被句号切断

原: Questions 12 to 15 are based on the passage you have just heard, Question 12: …
疑为: Questions 12 to 15 are based on the passage you have just heard. Question 12: …
理由: 念题套话与第 12 题连成了一句；译文分成两句

原: Would that give me more freedom and more time.
疑为: Would that give me more freedom and more time?

原: …lies that are meant to benefit others, the first, as you may predict, is for selfish gain…
疑为: …lies that are meant to benefit others. The first, as you may predict, is for selfish gain…

原: …watching music videos, your favorite songs and artists become familiar…
